SPPL2a is a B-cell-specific intramembrane protease that controls the maturation of B cells by cleaving the invariant chain (CD74), whereas SPPL2b is a ubiquitously expressed intramembrane metalloprotease with a yet undefined function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SPPL2b is not a suitable target for pharmacological modulation of B cell numbers in autoimmune disorders.
SPPL2b has no significant role in B and dendritiic cell homeostasis and therefore cannot be targeted for B-cell depletion.
SPPL2a is the only protease that can proteolyze the CD74 NTF in vivo.
